kcc_query_text_example: Marginal farmer with 1.8 acres dryland black cotton soil in Jewargi taluk, Kalaburagi preparing for sunflower/Bengalgram sowing; yield has dropped over last 2 years despite DAP application; need soil sample testing and Soil Health Card nutrient recommendations.

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: RTC registered pre-February 2019 in Jewargi taluk

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: NSS 77th Round: Marginal dryland oilseed cultivators in Jewargi taluk, black soil vertisols requiring secondary and micronutrient management.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka soil fertility query logs: Farmers seeking soil testing procedure, lab turnaround times, and fertilizer dosage guidance following repeated crop yellowing.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Evaluates Soil Health Card as universal diagnostic entitlement; distinguishes free diagnostic advisory service from separate commercial fertilizer purchase subsidies; verifies General Merit exclusion from targeted corporation schemes (GK_PARENT_REGISTRY_CORPORATION_MISMATCH); confirms clean eligibility for PM-KISAN, PMFBY, and Krishi Bhagya.

intended_test_purpose: Evaluate universal access to Soil Health Card diagnostic profiling; test distinction between diagnostic testing and input subsidies; verify General Merit corporation exclusion.
unresolved_dependencies: Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) Jewargi taluk soil testing lab sample collection and processing timeline for 2026-27
